hypothesis: Compact role and scene anchors, with explicit example dialogue, can improve a small local teacher without changing its weights.
matched: Same model, tokenizer, temperature .75, top_p .9, first caller turns and per-case seed. Changing prompt content is the intended intervention.
acceptance: Judge scene perspective, character/world consistency, naturalness, completion and excessive assistant framing. No automatic admission. A first-turn pass must be followed by multi-turn pilot.
